D=Path('diagnostics');D.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def probe():
 x={'find_library':ctypes.util.find_library('gtk-3')}
 try:
  lib=ctypes.CDLL('libgtk-3.so.0')
  x['loaded']=True
  x['version']='.'.join(str(getattr(lib,'gtk_get_'+part+'_version')()) for part in ('major','minor','micro'))
 except Exception:x['loaded']=False;x['exception']=traceback.format_exc()
 return x
def run(label,cmd,timeout):
 start=time.time()
 try:
  with (D/(label+'.log')).open('w') as log:
   p=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=timeout)
  result={'command':cmd,'returncode':p.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.time()-start,'log':str(D/(label+'.log'))}
 except Exception:result={'command':cmd,'exception':traceback.format_exc()}
 r[label]=result
 print(label,json.dumps(result),flush=True)
